WITH grouped_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.translink,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as count_records
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    translink,
    tradekind,
    count_records,
    CAST(count_records AS NUMERIC) / SUM(count_records) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) as share
  FROM grouped_counts
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(share) as avg_share_for_type
  FROM with_shares
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.translink,
    ws.tradekind,
    ws.count_records,
    ws.share,
    ta.avg_share_for_type
  FROM with_shares ws
  INNER JOIN type_averages ta ON ws.tradekind = ta.tradekind
  WHERE ws.share > ta.avg_share_for_type
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(count_records) as avg_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share) - MAX(avg_share_for_type) as avg_margin
FROM filtered
GROUP BY tradekind;
